pages.text: Mana is the energy that powers certain trinkets and racial abilities.$(br2)It refills over time, so use powerful effects with care.

Mana answers to intent. With knowledge and practice, it can be shaped into powerful effects.$(br2)Use $(l:mana/mana_candy)Mana Candy$(/l) to recover mana, or read $(l:mana/altering_maximum_mana)Altering Maximum Mana$(/l) to learn how to increase your reserves.
